top_signals.title: People Don't Know Their Retirement Number: Conrath
top_signals.summary:
Michael Conrath, chief retirement strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how inflation is causing Americans to rethink their retirement saving goals.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Hackers target government Windows systems in Asia with new malware
top_signals.summary: The previously unknown malware, dubbed NetamLoader, uses legitimate Microsoft software components to execute malicious code, evade security tools and download additional programs onto infected computers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
